summary.tldr: Requires certain enclosed-cockpit gliders and the aircraft that tow them to have a GPS-based collision avoidance system.
what_it_does: Adds a rule to the Aeronautics Act that requires gliders with an enclosed cockpit and a weight over 200 kg to be equipped with a GPS-based collision avoidance system.
Also requires any aircraft used to tow those gliders to have the same GPS-based collision avoidance system.
States that this requirement applies in addition to any existing security requirements for equipment, systems and processes.
who_it_affects: Owners and operators of enclosed-cockpit gliders
summary.background: It amends section 4.71 of the Aeronautics Act.
